reviews.review: Like a genious Left 4 Dead type for the Alien Franchise, top!
Boring as ♥♥♥♥, only playable with friends
Yes. Game is good would say catch it on a sale before you buy it though. And have a couple friends to run it with.

[h1]Left 4 AlienTide[/h1]

As a random person who experienced the majority of Alien/Predator/AvP games since 80's to this day - I can tell you with certainty - THIS. IS THE MOST FUN Aliens game there is. It may not be the most intense one - but the most fun one for sure.

[h1]Look at this ugly thing...ITS AWESOME[/h1]
On a technical level, the visuals in this game are nothing special. Unreal Engine 4, with mediocre textures, effects and some minor FPS drops but nothing critical.
But if you are a fan of Alien-verse. You will love the aestethics of this game. Not only there are references to various Alien media, vistas and such, but also really detailed layout of abandoned factories, Alien hive and also various ancient ruins. And the lighting - is on point.

[h1]First impression - FUN. Later - its Grind[/h1]
At the start of the game - you will create your character right. Then you will be thrown into the hub, talk to some NPC and then queue up the game. If you dont have friends/dont wanna play with randoms/servers are empty - you can play with literal bots - Synths who will accompany if you are lonely. Though, dont expect a lot from them. (There is also a mod to make them more useful than petty humies)
Then its 4 campaigns about running from A to B - shooting a bunch of aliens/Stronger Aliens and also so much more. Since the devs didn't feared to add more variety to enemies. You'll see it for youselves. After each mission you will be rewarded with experience points, some loot to customize your character on basic level - and then the next mission.
After you beat the game (12 missions without the DLC) the game will tell you - welp, its Grinding time, since there's nothing left to do anymore. You can do achievment hunting, complete Daylies, try out extra difficulty levels - but if you not interested in any of that - the game is done,

[h1]Obligatory Plot - Not Needed but Very Important[/h1]
Basically, you will be sent to some colony, again, as in every Alien game - to investigate, clear out, find the source of problems, get out - and thats. it.
Occasionally, some NPCs will fill you out on various popular Alien media, like movies or Alien Isolation - to widen up your lore.
But mostly - its all about easter eggs for fans.

[h1]Whymsical music[/h1]
Shoutout to the composer who made all the music tracks for this game.
Each campaign has its own ambient music and also layers for anything happening in the game - be that extra waves, boss battle or simple headshots. Kudos for that.

[h1]Immersive Tunnels[/h1]
Since the game is all about tunnel vision - dont expect a lot from this game. 
But if you dont care about Open World games - if will suffice.
Abandoned/ruined maintenance corridors
Jungle planet surface
Ancient ruins
Infested corridors 
Hive 
Also easter eggs and vistas
Levels in this game are as Alien-like as they could be.

[h1]The most weakest parts of the game[/h1]
Characters and replay factor
NPCs do not have lip syncing, no budget for that. They will communicate with you through text and telephatic connection.
You character - is basic as hell - basically , its YOU in the game.
There is however some more detailed info about some characters if you collect some Intel - but its not very interesting.

Lastly, the game is alive thanks to the veterans of this game. But barely. They are friendly most of the times. But it doesn't change the fact that if you wanna to 100% this game - get ready to GRIND a lot
Bots are dumb
Higher levels of difficulty will wreck you unless you play really smart
And there are not many levels sadly and some of them - do not even have Xenomorphs in them.
If you Really like this game - then you will probably stick to it for a few months.
Otherwise - if will bore you really fast.

[h1]TL;DR: - Game Over Man, GAME OVER[/h1]
Fun, Stunning, barely alive atm
But short - with lots of grind.
